name: Account Export and Deletion
description: Export all account data in a portable format. Delete account with cascading cleanup of profile, memberships, sessions, and devices. Both operations are receipted.
purpose: Comply with data portability and right-to-deletion requirements while maintaining an auditable trail.
acceptanceCriteria: Export manifest schema defines all data categories included in an export
Export produces a signed archive with all account data in portable format (JSON, content-addressed blobs)
Export is receipted with snapshot hash and timestamp
Delete flow: confirmation required, cascading cleanup of profile, memberships, sessions, devices, recovery credentials
Deletion receipted with principal ID, timestamp, and cleanup manifest
Deletion grace period configurable (optional undo window)
Data retention after deletion: metadata only (receipts, audit logs) for compliance
